# FSD Home Services

FSD Home Services is a verified local service marketplace connecting homeowners with trusted plumbers, electricians, AC technicians, carpenters, painters, masons, CCTV technicians, solar technicians, contractors, and other skilled professionals across Faisalabad, Pakistan.

## Services
- Plumber
- Electrician
- AC Technician
- Carpenter
- Painter
- Mason
- Laborer
- CCTV Technician
- Solar Technician
- Contractor / Thekedaar
- Construction & Renovation
- Marble & Tile Fitting
- Welding & Metal Fabrication
- Ceiling / False Ceiling
- Waterproofing
- Cleaning Services
